storyCards.headline: I Put A Spell On You: A Cultural Moment Captured on Record
storyCards.fact:
Creedence Clearwater Revival's "I Put A Spell On You" reached #58 on the Billboard Hot 100. Creedence Clearwater Revival is the debut studio album by the American rock band Creedence Clearwater Revival, released in June 1968, by Fantasy Records in the US.

The song peaked at #58 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 9 weeks on the chart.

Graph compilation anchor: "Chronicle (The 20 Greatest Hits)" (1976) — not the song's original release year.

"I Put A Spell On You" by Creedence Clearwater Revival.
